entities.name: Gruul Clans
aliases: the guild which is not one
entities.description: The red-green anarchic guild of Ravnica, a loose affiliation of clans formerly charged with maintaining the wild places.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane of the guilds.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact binding the guilds, outside of which the Gruul came to be seen.

entities.name: Borborygmos
entities.description: Cyclops of the Burning Tree Clan and long-time largest clan leader, defeated by Domri Rade but later returning to leadership.

entities.name: Domri Rade
entities.description: Planeswalker who, at Bolas's urging, defeated Borborygmos and became guildleader; he later died.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon who urged Domri to challenge Borborygmos.

entities.name: Burning Tree Clan
entities.description: The most influential, largest and most diverse Gruul clan, Borborygmos's clan.

entities.name: Scab Clan
entities.description: The most violent clan, made of members tortured or crippled by civilization.

entities.name: Narbulg Nine Fingers
entities.description: Corpulent giant leader of the Scab Clan.

entities.name: Ghor Clan
entities.description: The clan that executes the most frequent and savage assaults on Ravnican citizens.

entities.name: Ruric Thar
entities.description: Leader of the Ghor Clan.

entities.name: Bolrac Clan
entities.description: Clan of ogres, cyclopes, trolls and giants who bring down structures with mauls; leadership changes frequently.

entities.name: Slizt Clan
entities.description: Stealthy clan of viashino and humans.

entities.name: Zhur-Taa Clan
entities.description: The most religious clan, practicing the Old Ways and awaiting Ilharg.

entities.name: Nikya
entities.description: Centaur leader of the Zhur-Taa Clan, who bottlenecked the Golgari with constricting vine magic.

entities.name: Gravel Hide Clan
entities.description: A relatively new clan that believes resilience is the truest strength.

entities.name: Skorik Boulder Tooth
entities.description: Hot-tempered goblin leader of the Gravel Hide Clan.

entities.name: Ilharg
entities.description: An ancient boar god whose awakening the Zhur-Taa await.

entities.name: Ulasht
entities.description: A hellion revered by many Gruul as an embodiment of pure destruction.

entities.name: End-Raze
entities.description: The coming apocalypse in which Ilharg tramples Ravnica's skylines.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which the Gruul fought for Ravnica's defense.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: The ruined districts where the Gruul live and expand.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: Guild held back from the surface by Nikya's vines.

events.summary: Civilization and the other guilds overrun every wild place, stripping the Gruul of their responsibilities and changing them.
events.quote: Civilization and the other nine guilds, however, overran every wild place on the plane.

events.summary: Seen as outside the Guildpact, the Gruul are written out of the law by the Azorius and left exploitable by the Orzhov.
events.quote: they were seen as outside of the Guildpact, and the Azorius began to write them out of the law

events.summary: At Bolas's urging Domri Rade defeats Borborygmos by setting waves of beasts on him; Borborygmos loses the Gruul's respect.
events.quote: the planeswalker Domri Rade challenged and defeated the aging Borborygmos by setting waves of beasts on the cyclops

events.summary: Domri Rade ascends as guildleader and the time of the End-Raze is thought to have come.
events.quote: the ascension of Domri Rade as guildleader

events.summary: After the War of the Spark and Domri's death, Borborygmos becomes acting guildmaster again.
The Gruul fight in Ravnica's defense in the Phyrexian invasion; Borborygmos gains respect and Nikya blocks the Golgari from the surface.
events.quote: Borborygmos' ferocious fighting earned him even more respect and loyalty.

events.summary: After the invasion the clans occupy ruins and expand their territory, disrupting rebuilding and clashing with the Boros.
events.quote: Efforts to rebuild Ravnica are constantly and actively disrupted by the Gruul.
